name: workspace_suggestions_cases
description: suggest.set ('Go further' next steps) shared by the backend (workspace/protocol.py + reducer.py) and the frontend (composables/workspaceModel.js). normalize_cases: normalize(input, default_ts) deep-equals expected (null = op dropped); an expected event re-normalizes to itself. reducer_cases: fold 'events' from the empty state; 'expected' is the full reduced state (deep equality), 'expected_suggestions' its suggestions (null = key ABSENT, the only 'no suggestions' form; read state.suggestions || []); 'persisted' = the backend writes the row (reducer.is_empty is false); 'opens_studio' = the state has a plan, a note or a widget (suggestions alone never open the Studio).
